name: asktoto
description: Métis — AI desktop overlay assistant (package name kept for dev-profile continuity)
author: Tony Walteur <tony.walteur@gmail.com>

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.local-ai-worker.json
scripts.build:intelligence: cd intelligence && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.predist: node scripts/check-ffmpeg-sidecar.mjs mac && node scripts/check-sherpa-platform.mjs mac && node scripts/fetch-models.mjs && npm run check:local-ai -- --platform darwin-arm64 && npm run build:intelligence
scripts.dist:local: node scripts/check-ffmpeg-sidecar.mjs mac && node scripts/check-sherpa-platform.mjs mac && npm run check:local-ai -- --platform darwin-arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never -c.directories.output=/Users/tony/AI-Brain-build/asktoto-release -c.mac.identity='TotoWhisper Dev' && node scripts/verify-signing.mjs
scripts.dist:unpacked:mac: node scripts/check-ffmpeg-sidecar.mjs mac && node scripts/check-sherpa-platform.mjs mac && npm run check:local-ai -- --platform darwin-arm64 && npm run build:intelligence && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir --publish never
scripts.predist:win: node scripts/check-ffmpeg-sidecar.mjs win && node scripts/check-sherpa-platform.mjs win && node scripts/fetch-models.mjs && npm run check:local-ai -- --platform win32-x64
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-models.mjs && npm run build:intelligence && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:unpacked:win: node scripts/check-ffmpeg-sidecar.mjs win && node scripts/check-sherpa-platform.mjs win && npm run check:local-ai -- --platform win32-x64 && npm run build:intelligence && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:win:appx: node scripts/check-ffmpeg-sidecar.mjs win && node scripts/check-sherpa-platform.mjs win && npm run build && electron-builder --win appx --x64 --publish never
scripts.release: node scripts/check-ffmpeg-sidecar.mjs mac && node scripts/check-sherpa-platform.mjs mac && npm run check:xcode && node scripts/check-release-secrets.mjs mac && npm run check:release && node scripts/fetch-models.mjs && npm run build:intelligence && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish always
scripts.release:win: node scripts/check-ffmpeg-sidecar.mjs win && node scripts/check-sherpa-platform.mjs win && node scripts/check-release-secrets.mjs win && npm run check:release && node scripts/fetch-models.mjs && npm run build:intelligence && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish always
scripts.release:mas: node scripts/check-ffmpeg-sidecar.mjs mac && node scripts/check-sherpa-platform.mjs mac && npm run check:xcode && node scripts/check-release-secrets.mjs mas && node scripts/fetch-models.mjs && npm run build:intelligence && npm run build && electron-builder --mac mas --publish never -c.mas.provisioningProfile="$MAS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE"
scripts.release:win:store: node scripts/check-ffmpeg-sidecar.mjs win && node scripts/check-sherpa-platform.mjs win && node scripts/check-release-secrets.mjs win-store && node scripts/fetch-models.mjs && npm run build:intelligence && npm run build && electron-builder --win appx --x64 --publish never

comment: Only main-process runtime deps live in 'dependencies' (electron-builder bundles these into the app). All renderer deps are bundled by Vite at build time and kept in devDependencies to keep the package small.
